fields.mechanism: Albendazole reduces cyst viability and fluid production, potentially decreasing proteinaceous debris and clot formation.
fields.intervention: Local delivery of albendazole via the external ventricular drain catheter to reduce proteinaceous debris and clot formation.
fields.expected_effect: Prolonged catheter patency without systemic anticoagulation.
fields.falsification_test: Compare catheter occlusion rates in patients receiving local albendazole versus placebo over the required monitoring period.

fields.mechanism: Hydatid cyst embolization causing intracerebral hemorrhage via cyst rupture and embolic shower
fields.intervention: Coat EVD catheter with a hydatid cyst-derived protoscolex-binding peptide to sequester embolic debris
fields.expected_effect: Reduced catheter occlusion by capturing and retaining embolic hydatid material before it enters the catheter lumen
fields.falsification_test: In vitro flow model simulating EVD drainage with hydatid cyst debris; measure catheter patency over 72 hours with vs without peptide coating
fields.mechanism_source_span: "cardiac hydatid cyst...he acutely developed right-sided hemiparesis and loss of consciousness"
